faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes GLC63 AMG use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the generation. The X253 (2015-2022) uses the M177 4.0-litre V8 biturbo. The current X254 (2022-present) uses the M139 2.0-litre 4-cylinder hybrid - a significant departure from the V8. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes GLC63 AMG engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds for the X253 generation with the M177 V8 start from £6,500. Pricing for the current X254 generation's M139 hybrid has not yet been established - contact us with your registration for a fixed-price quote. Exact price depends on condition and parts required.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my GLC63 AMG?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M177 V8 or the M139 hybrid before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M177 GLC63 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace valve seals, coolant components, timing chains and bearings as standard on every M177 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M139 GLC63 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The M139 is the current-generation hybrid engine - we service it to the same high standard as our other GLC63 AMG rebuilds, without inheriting assumptions from the older V8.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used GLC63 AMG engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my GLC63 AMG if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a GLC63 AMG engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most GLC63 AMG owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
